description:
Audit rank: 28 of 30.

Owner: JC-01 Application foundation.
Evidence: lib/jido_console/error.ex:19-68 defines Splode classes, while error.ex:74-353 and callers use a parallel plain-exception normalization path.
Work: Make Splode the single project error system. Convert project-owned error types and normalization to use the Splode classes and APIs. Remove the parallel ad-hoc taxonomy and normalization branches after all callers use Splode.
Acceptance: Every project-owned user-facing error has one Splode class, stable message, structured fields, and redaction. CLI, automation, coding, session, provider, and release error paths normalize through Jido.Console.Error and Splode. Error tests cover classification, wrapping, redaction, and fallback.

Project state: unreleased. Do not add compatibility aliases, deprecation paths, legacy decoders, or old-arity shims.

comments.text: Implemented as 654c997 on jido_console-1f1.28/splode-errors. Project leaf errors now use Splode, normalize and serialize through Jido.Console.Error, and redact messages and structured fields. Validation: 71 focused tests passed after final rebase; broad unit suite passed 538 tests with 11 platform-tagged exclusions; isolated Darwin process test passed; production escript build, --version, and --help passed. mix precommit reached Dialyzer and failed on six pre-existing release warnings in release/homebrew.ex, release/matrix.ex, and release/npm.ex; no error was in this task's files. The compiled PTY expect test built but one flow exited early.

title: F-02: Convert project errors to Splode
